metric: New offers saved with a status/decision-date contradiction
baseline: 4/5 Pending offers carry a Decision On (snapshot)
baseline_status: Measured on snapshot; re-measure on live data at release
measurement_method: Count of offers created or updated after release violating the rule

metric: Share of pre-existing Pending offers resolved (true status + date) within 30 days of pilot start
baseline: 5 Pending, of which 4 conflicting (snapshot); live count recorded at release
target_or_decision_rule: Decision rule: >= 80% resolved in 30 days -> queue works; below -> interview recruiters on blockers

metric: Reported acceptance figure in VP review uses OAM-01 with counts, OAM-02 labelled as ratio, and pending backlog
target_or_decision_rule: Yes/No at the end-of-Q3 VP review

metric: Pending offers older than 30 days with no Expires On and no update in 30 days, at month end
baseline: 3/5 Pending older than 30 days at provisional cutoff 2026-08-27 (5/5 at 2026-11-24)
baseline_status: Snapshot; cutoff-sensitive; live baseline at release
target_or_decision_rule: 0 at each month end after the backlog is resolved
target_status: Provisional (threshold depends on expiry policy C-03)

metric: Status accuracy: share of queue resolutions confirmed correct in a monthly 10-offer audit sample
target_or_decision_rule: Threshold: < 90% confirmed -> pause bulk resolution, review reasons
measurement_method: Recruiting-ops lead reviews 10 random resolutions vs email/ATS evidence

metric: Offer status changes without an audit event
baseline: Not measurable today (no event log exists)
target_status: Firm (enforced: status changes only via the event log)
measurement_method: Reconcile current status with last event per offer

metric: Accepted offers whose application is not Hired (consistency)
Share of inactivity-flagged applications dispositioned within 30 days of being flagged
target_or_decision_rule: Decision rule: >= 50% in pilot -> continue; < 50% -> review UX and threshold with recruiters

metric: Inactivity-flag share of Active applications (no recorded activity > configured threshold, default 90 days; a flag, not confirmed abandonment)
baseline: 50/105 Active (snapshot, provisional cutoff); 104/105 at extraction date
baseline_status: Snapshot is ~3 months old: live baseline required (B2.3, sprint 3)
target_or_decision_rule: No numerical target until live baseline; proposed intent: halve the live baseline within one quarter of pilot

metric: Openings whose Status contradicts their applications and are not flagged
target_or_decision_rule: 0 unflagged after release; decision rule: >= 50% of flags resolved within 14 days
evaluation_window: Continuous; resolution reviewed at day 14 and 30

metric: Active applications on Filled openings
target_or_decision_rule: No numerical target until live baseline

metric: Share of reviewed inactivity flags that the recruiter confirms as abandoned (pilot: 20 sampled applications)
baseline: No baseline: inactivity flags are not abandonment (50/105 flagged at 90 days is a flag rate)
target_or_decision_rule: Decision rule: < 50% confirmed abandoned in the 20-application pilot -> cut the queue to opening flags only
measurement_method: Recruiter classification of 20 randomly sampled flagged applications

metric: Closed-by-disposition applications reopened within 30 days
target_or_decision_rule: Threshold: > 5% -> raise stall threshold / review reasons

metric: New applications with Source/Referred By contradiction
New applications with application-level Source and Intake Method captured
target_or_decision_rule: 100% of UI-created applications (mandatory fields); imports tracked separately
target_status: Firm for UI path; imports provisional

metric: Intake-method mix for Job Board applications (share entered manually)
baseline: Not measurable today (no intake data, C-12)
target_or_decision_rule: No target: measurement input to the N1 decision at Q4 planning

metric: Duplicate-warning precision: share of warnings the recruiter resolves as 'same person' (attach to existing record; no merge)
baseline: No baseline; snapshot has 12/300 candidates in name+phone pairs
target_or_decision_rule: Decision rule: < 50% over first 50 warnings -> tighten match rule

metric: Duplicate warnings re-shown for a pair already marked 'different person'
measurement_method: Count of warnings on pairs in the not-duplicate list

metric: Candidate records merged or deleted by the duplicate feature
target_status: Firm (enforced: feature has no merge or delete path)
measurement_method: Audit of candidate record deletions/merges attributed to the feature

metric: Median time to create an application
baseline: No baseline: instrument 2 weeks before release
target_or_decision_rule: Threshold: > 20% increase vs pre-release baseline -> simplify form
